text:
[LCCO.7.6] **An answer ends the call's timeouts.** A response fact or
`CallError` on the call's correlation retracts every timer fact of that call,
whether or not an `on` or `error` clause matches it. No `timeout` body of the
call runs after the answer, including once the answer has expired or been
superseded.

The compiler must lower this to two synthetic rules per `timeout` clause,
`$<outer>_timeout_<N>_answered` and `$<outer>_timeout_<N>_failed`, with `<N>` as
[LCCO.4.1] counts it. Each joins the clause's timer fact on `corr` with the
service's response schema ([LCRS.4.3.2]) or with `CallError` respectively, and
its RHS is the retraction of the timer. Neither retracts the capture fact
([LCCO.5.2]): an `on` or `error` sibling of the same answer joins it.
